channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: A popular Bay Area coffee pop-up is opening its first location in Union Square
item.description: Painted Leopard is the official coffee partner for the recently reopened RealReal flagship store in San Francisco.

item.title: Build your own 49ers: Can you assemble a Super Bowl contender for 2026?
item.description: With NFL free agency set to start next week, it’s time to put your team-building skills to the test.

item.title: Who’s Nate Williams? Meet the Warriors player pushing for a coveted roster spot
item.description: Golden State collapsed in the second half against the Los Angeles Clippers, but a two-way guard made a strong impression on Steve Kerr.

item.title: Remember the $1.7 million toilet? Lurie seeks to fix rules that led to SF embarrassment
item.description: The mayor would empower the city administrator to streamline purchasing rules in a ballot measure.

item.title: Supervisors grill Waymo about 1,500 stalled cars during December blackout
item.description: The company apologized but said it still expects San Francisco first responders to help move stranded robotaxis.

item.title: Charli XCX, Rüfüs Du Sol, The Strokes headline alt-heavy Outside Lands
item.description: Hip-hop takes a back seat for 2026, as it’s all about indie acts, psych rockers, and guitars, guitars, guitars.

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: Macklin Celebrini isn’t the only reason the Sharks are on the rise
item.description: GM Mike Grier and coach Ryan Warsofsky have watched young players, including Will Smith and Michael Misa, turn San Jose into a playoff contender.

item.title: A very serious investigation into the dog dookie dispute rocking Presidio Heights
item.description: Rampant dog droppings spark a potential overreaction.

item.title: ‘You’re killing her!’: Witnesses recount horrific Mission Bay crash where 2-year-old died
item.description: Bystanders tried to lift an SUV after its driver pinned a mother and child in Mission Bay, say witnesses.

item.title: It was billed as the hottest new party in SF. It sounded like ‘a wash of noise’
item.description: Sound issues plague the first night of SF’s newest EDM sensation.
